background.prompt: 超现实主义艺术时尚摄影，70 年代复古胶片质感，高饱和撞色，16:9 横幅；主体必须位于画面正中央，画面上半部中间留出大面积干净的天空或纯色区域用于放置白色标题；不要任何文字、水印、logo。一片开满红色虞美人的田野，远处是淡蓝色天空和低矮山丘。画面正中站着一个穿浅色风衣的人，他的脸被一圈刺眼的白色光晕和横向的油画笔触涂抹得看不清，像被强光照到过曝，身后拖着轻微的动态残影。

lines.zh: 极度自卑的人，其实也是极度自信的人。
lines.en: Extreme self-doubt is a kind of extreme self-importance.

lines.zh: 因为他觉得，所有人都在看着他。
lines.en: Because he believes everyone is watching him.

lines.zh: 我们总觉得，别人的目光像一束聚光灯，
lines.en: We feel that others' eyes are like a spotlight,

lines.zh: 走到哪，就照到哪。
lines.en: following us wherever we go.

lines.zh: 头发没洗，你觉得全世界都看出来了；
lines.en: Skip a hair wash, and you think the whole world can tell.

lines.zh: 跟人打招呼对方没听见，你举着的手都不知道往哪放；
lines.en: Wave at someone who doesn't notice, and your hand freezes in the air.

lines.zh: 群里发错一句话，整晚翻来覆去，
lines.en: Send one wrong message in the group chat, and you toss all night,

lines.zh: 仿佛别人正在开会，研究你有多蠢。
lines.en: as if others were holding a meeting on how foolish you are.

lines.zh: 心理学管这叫聚光灯效应。
lines.en: Psychologists call this the spotlight effect.

lines.zh: 康奈尔大学做过一个实验，
lines.en: Cornell University ran an experiment,

lines.zh: 让学生穿着印着明星大头照的T恤，走进教室。
lines.en: sending students into a classroom in a T-shirt with a celebrity's face.

lines.zh: 他们猜，至少一半的人会注意到，
lines.en: They guessed at least half the room would notice,

lines.zh: 可真正注意到的，还不到四分之一。
lines.en: but fewer than a quarter actually did.

lines.zh: 你以为别人盯着你的缺点，
lines.en: You think people are staring at your flaws,

lines.zh: 其实别人也在盯着自己的缺点。
lines.en: but they are busy staring at their own.

lines.zh: 我刚工作时，第一次汇报就翻错了PPT，
lines.en: At my first job, I clicked the wrong slide in my first presentation,

lines.zh: 之后半个月，开会都不敢抬头。
lines.en: and for two weeks I couldn't look up in meetings.

lines.zh: 直到同事说：你那次讲得挺好的啊。
lines.en: Until a colleague said: you did great that time.

lines.zh: 原来我记住的，是自己的狼狈；
lines.en: What I remembered was my own embarrassment;

lines.zh: 别人记住的，也许只是那天天气不错。
lines.en: what others remembered was maybe just the nice weather.

lines.zh: 那束聚光灯，其实是我们自己打的。
lines.en: That spotlight is one we aim at ourselves.

lines.zh: 不是别人在审视你，是你在审判自己。
lines.en: It's not others examining you; it's you judging yourself.

lines.zh: 世界不是一个审判你的考场，
lines.en: The world is not an exam hall that judges you,

lines.zh: 它更像一个人来人往的广场。
lines.en: it's more like a square where people come and go.

lines.zh: 你可以紧张，但别把紧张当成预言；
lines.en: You can be nervous, but don't treat nerves as prophecy;

lines.zh: 你可以出错，但不必一遍遍回放。
lines.en: you can make mistakes, but you don't need to replay them.

lines.zh: 所谓成长，就是慢慢关掉那束不存在的聚光灯，
lines.en: Growing up is slowly switching off a spotlight that never existed,

lines.zh: 然后发现，大家都忙着过自己的日子，
lines.en: and finding that everyone is busy living their own lives,

lines.zh: 你也可以放心地，去过你的。
lines.en: so you can safely go live yours.
